fair: fair_sharp at the bet's snapshot (lowvig/betonlineag main spreads + juice, fallback all books)
one_bet_per: game per window (highest fair EV); if no window given, the early bet only

candidates.desc: Any alt line (bought OR sold, within 3.5 pts of that book's main line, price -300..+300) at an allowed book at the ~75-min close snapshot with fair_sharp EV >= +1%; one bet per game (highest EV).
candidates.edge_if: ROI - 1.64*SE > 0 (CLV == model EV at the same snapshot, so not an independent test)

candidates.desc: Same as B1 at the early snapshot (Fri 21:40 UTC / kickoff-24h); judged on CLV vs the close fair_sharp.
Systematic buy ONTO 3 or 7 at the close: book main +2.5 -> +3, -3.5 -> -3, +6.5 -> +7, -7.5 -> -7 at that same book's alt price; best allowed book by fair EV; no EV filter; one per game.
